title: DeveloperConfig
description: Content of the portfolio. Everything the site shows about you lives in developer.json and must follow this schema.

$schema.description: Path or URL of this schema, so that your editor can validate and autocomplete developer.json.

name.description: Your full name. Shown on the home page and in the browser title.

logo_name.description: Short name shown as the logo in the header, e.g. "john-doe".

role.description: Your role, typed out on the home page, e.g. "Front-end developer".

sections.description: Sections of the about page, keyed by their slug. The key must match the section title.

title.description: Title of the direct contacts block, e.g. "contacts".

sources.description: Direct contact channels keyed by icon name: the key "email" renders /icons/email.svg, "phone" renders /icons/phone.svg.

social.description: Social profiles shown in the footer.

sources.description: Other profiles, keyed by a slug of your choice.

gists.description: Public GitHub gist IDs shown as code snippets on the about page, keyed by display order.

additionalProperties.description: The ID of a public gist: the hexadecimal part of its URL, https://gist.github.com/<user>/<id>.

projects.description: Projects shown on the projects page, keyed by display order.

AboutFolder.title: AboutFolder
AboutFolder.description: A folder inside an about section. Its key is the label shown in the menu.

title.description: Folder slug. Must match the key.

description.description:
Text shown as a code comment when the folder is selected. Basic HTML such as
is allowed.

files.description: Optional files listed under the folder, keyed by file name.

title.description: Section slug. Must match the key.

icon.description: Icon path under public/, starting with a slash, e.g. "/icons/info-personal.svg".

info.description: Folders of the section, keyed by their slug.

description.description: Short description shown on the card.

img.description: Image path under public/, starting with a slash, or an absolute URL.

tech.description: Technologies used. Each one needs an icon in public/icons/techs/ and public/icons/techs/filled/ named in lowercase, e.g. "React" uses react.svg.

url.description: Link opened by the view-project button.

title.description: Label of the link, e.g. "Github profile".

url.description: Base URL of the service, ending with a slash, e.g. "https://github.com/".

user.description: Your user name on that service. The link is url + user.
